- calendar-api (port 5001) — systemd
- cloudflared (port 20241) — systemd
- tailscaled — systemd
- docker + n8n (port 5678) — docker-compose restart: unless-stopped
- PM2 webhook-server (port 3847) — pm2 startup + save
